name: AnyPS5
description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
readme_summary: AnyPS5 is a tool designed to automatically port PlayStation 5 executables to Linux and Windows. It achieves this by relinking the executables to the target system's native format and providing implementations of system PRX libraries for dynamic linking, without requiring emulation or a separate runtime process.
key_features: Automatic porting of PS5 executables to Linux and Windows
Relinker for converting executables to native formats
Implementations of system PRX libraries for dynamic linking
No emulation or separate runtime process required
SDL-mapped controller support and input mapping configuration
primary_use_case: Porting PlayStation 5 games and applications to run on PC (Linux and Windows) without emulation.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, representing AnyPS5, is meticulously assembling a complex clockwork mechanism. The input is a jumbled pile of gears and springs labeled 'PS5 Executable', while the output is a smoothly running, polished clockwork device labeled 'PC Native'. The artisan uses specialized tools that emit glowing lines of code and data, connecting the input to the output. Subtle digital particles and small, stylized UI elements suggesting code compilation float around the scene. The background is a clean, modern workshop with soft, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and precision, showcasing the transformation process.

name: torrent-player
readme_summary: Torrent Player is a native Android application designed for downloading and streaming torrent files efficiently. It offers a user-friendly interface for managing downloads, selecting specific files, and playing content directly within the app or via external players, all while prioritizing battery life and low resource consumption.
key_features: Modern Material 3 Design with Jetpack Compose
primary_use_case: Downloading and streaming torrent files on Android devices with a focus on efficiency and user experience.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of a sleek Android device acting as a magical conduit. From the top, torrent files (represented as glowing, abstract data streams) flow into the device. Inside the device, a clear, organized pathway shows these streams being selectively filtered and then smoothly transitioning into a bright, playable video stream emanating from the screen. Subtle digital particles and a small, clean UI element showing download progress are visible. The background is a soft, gradient blue, emphasizing clarity and speed. The overall mood is efficient and modern, with the 'Torrent Player' name subtly integrated into the device's design. Style: 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a focus on visual flow.

name: Favnyr
description: A modern and lightweight file manager for Windows and Linux
readme_summary: Favnyr is a modern, lightweight, and portable file manager for Windows and Linux, built with Rust and Slint. It offers a private-by-construction approach with no network requests, telemetry, or installers, focusing on user control and productivity through features like side-by-side panels, workspaces, and custom commands.
key_features: No installer, admin rights, or telemetry
Ready-made recipes for common operations (compress, extract)
Recursive folder size and date calculation
primary_use_case: A fast, private, and highly configurable file management tool for users who need efficient organization and quick access to their files across different projects and layouts.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled cartographer meticulously drawing a complex map with multiple interconnected sections and detailed annotations. The cartographer uses a quill that draws glowing lines representing files and folders, organizing them into distinct regions (workspaces) and pinning important landmarks (favorites). Small, subtle UI elements resembling a modern file explorer interface are integrated into the map's legend. The scene is set in a cozy, well-lit study, emphasizing clarity and organization. The overall mood is one of productive control and efficiency. The art style should be a detailed 3D isometric illustration with a clean, organized composition and a palette of blues, greens, and warm wood tones, subtly incorporating the name 'Favnyr' on a rolled scroll.

name: Telegram-Drive
description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
readme_summary: Telegram Drive is an open-source desktop application that transforms your Telegram account into a cloud storage solution. It allows users to organize, transfer, preview, stream, sync, and share files stored in Telegram's Saved Messages and channels, acting as a local-first file workspace.
key_features: Organize, transfer, preview, stream, sync, and share files
Utilizes Telegram's Saved Messages and channels for storage
Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Google TV)
Local REST API and WebDAV support
Free to use with optional supporter license
primary_use_case: To provide users with a desktop-like file management experience for their Telegram messages and channels, effectively turning their Telegram account into a personal cloud storage drive.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, anthropomorphic filing cabinet with a friendly face, standing in a digital landscape. The filing cabinet has drawers labeled 'Telegram Saved Messages' and 'Telegram Channels'. From the drawers, streams of digital files (documents, images, videos) are flowing out and neatly organizing themselves into a sleek, modern desktop interface projected in front of the cabinet. Subtle glowing lines connect the cabinet to a stylized Telegram logo in the background. The overall mood is organized and efficient, with a clean, bright color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly iconography.

name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
readme_summary: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, and animations into MP4 videos. It's designed for use with AI coding agents, local CLI, and as a rendering core for authoring workflows.
primary_use_case: Generating MP4 videos from HTML and CSS code, particularly for use by AI agents to automate video creation.
cover_image_prompt: A digital loom weaving intricate threads of HTML code and CSS stylesheets into a vibrant, flowing tapestry of video. On one side, raw code is fed into the loom; on the other, a finished MP4 video emerges, complete with animated elements and background media. Subtle glowing particles representing data flow between the code and the video. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with soft, ambient lighting. The HyperFrames logo is subtly integrated into the loom's design. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with clear, defined lines and a visually appealing color scheme.
